name: University of Aveiro Data Center cooling and electrical reinforcement
notes: Diario da Republica public-procurement notice 13991/2026 covers works to reinforce cooling and electrical systems for the University of Aveiro data center in Glória e Vera Cruz, Aveiro, with EU funds and lots for datacenter cooling, dedicated electrical interconnection, generator, and electrical board. Instituto de Telecomunicacoes also identifies a datacenter at its Aveiro facility.

name: FF Ventures Aljustrel Data Center
notes: Aljustrel municipality announced a protocol with FF Ventures for a data center at the Mancoca Business and Logistics Park in Rio de Moinhos, Beja district. DCD/AICEP report an investment above EUR200m and note FF Ventures lists 310MW of data-center projects under development, including 264MW in Portugal, but no site-specific MW was disclosed.

name: CNCA / RNCA Guimaraes Data Center at University of Minho Azurém campus
developer: Fundacao para a Ciencia e a Tecnologia (FCT); DST Group
notes: DST says it is building the National Center for Advanced Computing data center in Guimaraes for EUR5m, located in the Azurém university district, to house advanced computing, University of Minho, European/national supercomputer, and RCTS equipment. DCD reports completion expected in September 2026. Guimaraes is in Braga district; DataCenterMap categorizes the regional market as Porto.

name: Instituto Politecnico de Braganca Datacenter
notes: Public Ciência Vitae project record lists the 'Projecto de Construcao do Datacenter do IPB / Datacenter IPB' at Instituto Politecnico de Braganca as concluded for 2007-2009. No current institutional facility page or capacity figure found, so confidence is weak and status is inferred from the completed campus datacenter project.

name: Covilha Data Center Campus
developer: Asterion Industrial Partners; Altice Portugal anchor tenant
notes: Input division 'White Castle' appears to refer to Castelo Branco district. Asterion announced acquisition of the Covilha Data Center Campus from Altice Portugal; the campus currently offers 6.8MW installed capacity and can accommodate up to 75MW additional on the existing campus, with potential c.175MW on adjacent land with power secured. Uptime Institute lists Portugal Telecom Data Center Covilha tier achievements.

name: AIBILI Data Centre
developer: AIBILI - Association for Innovation and Biomedical Research on Light and Image
notes: ECRIN lists AIBILI Data Centre in Coimbra as a certified data centre, and announced certification renewal approval in 2021. PtCRIN identifies AIBILI Data Centre Certification from ECRIN. This is a clinical research data centre rather than a commercial colocation/hyperscale facility; public MW not found.

name: Decsis Evora Data Center
notes: Decsis company history says construction of its state-of-the-art Evora data center occurred in 2011. DataCenterMap lists the Evora facility at Rua Circular Norte do Parque Industrial e Tecnológico de Evora with 1MW and 700 sqm. RTP/Lusa reported Decsis and HP Portugal were building the services data center in Evora in 2011.

name: University of Algarve TECH HUB Data Center at Campus da Penha
notes: University of Algarve procurement/technical page lists works for installation of the TECH HUB Data Center at Campus da Penha, including a second procedure. RNCA/FCCN identifies the University of Algarve advanced-computing visualization center as integrated with the UAlg data center in Faro, and UAlg also operates an Open Data Center initiative.

name: ULS Guarda / Hospital Sousa Martins Data Center
developer: Unidade Local de Saude da Guarda, EPE
notes: Diario da Republica public-procurement notices in May and August 2026 cover an eight-month maintenance contract for the ULS Guarda Data Center, including electrical infrastructure, UPS, cooling, servers, blade, storage and switching. Tender documents also identify the Hospital Sousa Martins data-processing center/data center in Guarda. Public MW not found.

name: Politecnico de Leiria Campus 2 Datacenter Container
notes: Rittal/Informantem case study says Instituto Politecnico de Leiria launched a public tender for a container infrastructure for a new datacenter at Campus 2 in Leiria. Politecnico de Leiria pages describe its main data center and centralization of about 70% of computing resources in the data center. Public MW not found.
